description: Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra: positioning datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra. Coverage: Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about positioning; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: GPDR – valstybinis geodezinio pagrindo duomenų rinkinys; Geodezinės ir kartografinės medžiagos fondo (GKMF) lapų schema su nuor; Struvės geodezinio lanko punktai. Formats seen: SHP, GDB. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
